title: Dedicated onboarding: ramp forecast visuals and throughput sentinel micro-illustrations
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact, scannable visual language for the Dedicated onboarding flow that focuses on two new concepts: (1) a ramp forecast timeline that helps teams estimate reserved capacity over the first 90 days, and (2) a ‘throughput sentinel’ micro-illustration set that explains autoscale gating, fallback tiers, and SLA implications. The scope includes high-fidelity mockups for three onboarding steps, a set of micro-animations (Lottie-ready), annotated screenshots for the docs site, and a lightweight component spec for engineering handoff.
deliverables: 3 high-fidelity screens: Ramp Forecast, Sentinel States, SLA Snapshot
Annotated screenshots for docs and quickstart (desktop + tablet)
Component spec: token list, spacing, responsive rules, accessible color pairs
Export package: PNG/SVG/Lottie + Drive folder with source Figma file
acceptance_criteria: Screens match console UI tokens and responsive breakpoints
Ramp forecast communicates cost and latency trade-offs at three scale scenarios
Sentinel micro-illustrations clearly map autoscale triggers to customer-visible outcomes
Engineering signoff on component spec and asset exports
Documentation screenshots accepted by Docs and Growth for the quickstart guide
design_notes: Prioritized contrast and iconography that scales down to 240px width for embedded docs
Avoided the typical capacity-card metaphor; chose a timeline with soft nodes to communicate ramping uncertainty
Sentinel states use a 3-color system: green/amber/indigo to indicate nominal/contended/fallback; included patterns for color-blind accessibility
Micro-animations should be <250KB when exported as Lottie; fallback to GIF for email usage
We propose an optional ‘expert mode’ toggle that shows raw throughput numbers for platform teams
